classificationRequirements.never_registered_in_observed_parser_hist: No CREATE/register/update/removal event for the target was observed in the compact local parser ledger before the first missing UPDATE, with the limitation that this is observed parser history only.
classificationRequirements.created_then_missing_registry_state_cand: A CREATE/register success for the target was observed before the boundary, but registryStateBefore at the missing UPDATE is missing and no sufficient removal evidence explains it.
classificationRequirements.removed_before_missing_update_candidate: A compact removal-like parser operation for the target was observed before the missing UPDATE; this is not a game destruction/death/objective claim.
classificationRequirements.entity_index_reused_or_generation_ambigu: Serial/generation or repeated index metadata makes local identity ambiguous without resolving game semantics.
classificationRequirements.index_stream_or_cursor_contract_suspecte: Read-count, indexDelta, or packet sequence metadata suggests local cursor/index interpretation may be involved.

confidencePolicy: Classifications are diagnostic candidates. They must include basis and limitations, and must not be promoted to facts.
